# vantorr

The `vantorr` package provides an R interface to the [Maxar / Vantor Hub
APIs](https://developers.maxar.com/docs/), enabling programmatic access
to high-resolution satellite imagery (such as Vivid Mosaic basemaps,
WorldView archives, and analysis-ready data). It natively integrates
with `sf`, `terra`, `stars`, `leaflet`, and `shiny`.

## Key Features

- **Flexible Authentication**: Session credential management via API
  Keys (`maxar-api-key`) or OAuth 2.0 Bearer Tokens
  ([`vantor_auth()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_auth.md))
  with automatic token caching and refresh.
- **Multi-Package Spatial Dispatch**: Pass `sf`, `terra` (`SpatRaster`,
  `SpatVector`, `SpatExtent`), or `stars` objects to any spatial query
  via
  [`vantor_as_bbox()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_as_bbox.md),
  and receive outputs as GeoTIFF files, `SpatRaster`, or `stars`
  objects.
- **Basemaps, Tiling & Seamline Metadata**: Download Vivid 30 cm / 15 cm
  GeoTIFFs
  ([`get_maxar_wms_basemap()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/get_maxar_wms_basemap.md)),
  automatically tile and mosaic large areas
  ([`get_maxar_wms_tiles()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/get_maxar_wms_tiles.md)),
  and retrieve vector seamline polygons with acquisition dates and
  sensor metadata via OGC WFS
  ([`vantor_get_seamlines()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_get_seamlines.md)).
- **Account Quota Monitoring**: Query credit limits and consumption
  breakdowns via the Usage API v2
  ([`vantor_get_usage()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_get_usage.md)).
- **Survey Fieldwork & World Bank Survey Solutions Resources**: Create
  alphanumeric survey index grids
  ([`vantor_survey_grid()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_survey_grid.md)),
  audit imagery vintage across Enumeration Areas
  ([`vantor_vintage_report()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_vintage_report.md)),
  encode offline Google Plus Codes
  ([`vantor_plus_code()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_plus_code.md)),
  export CAPI & Survey Solutions `.tab` preload tables
  ([`vantor_export_capi()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_export_capi.md)),
  generate multi-page printable PDF Field Atlases
  ([`vantor_field_atlas()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_field_atlas.md)),
  build multi-zoom Esri Tile Packages (`.tpk` / `.tpkx` and `_tpk.zip`
  via
  [`vantor_write_tpk()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_write_tpk.md)),
  and bundle offline GeoPackages & Shapefiles
  ([`vantor_offline_package()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_offline_package.md)).
- **Interactive `leaflet` & `shiny` Integration**: Stream WMTS/WMS
  basemaps, seamlines, and archive strips in `leaflet`
  ([`add_vantor_basemap()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/add_vantor_basemap.md),
  [`add_vantor_seamlines()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/add_vantor_seamlines.md),
  [`add_vantor_imagery()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/add_vantor_imagery.md)),
  or embed drop-in Shiny modules
  ([`vantor_auth_ui()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_auth_ui.md),
  [`vantor_explorer_ui()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_explorer_ui.md),
  [`run_vantor_demo_app()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/run_vantor_demo_app.md)).

## Installation

Once available on CRAN, you can install `vantorr` with:

``` r

install.packages("vantorr")
```

You can also install the development version of `vantorr` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/michael-cw/vantorr) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("michael-cw/vantorr", build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

## Authentication

The Vantor API supports both **API Keys** (long-lived, up to 180 days)
and **OAuth 2.0 Bearer Tokens** (session-based, with automatic refresh).
Note that different Vantor API services accept different credential
types:

- **OGC & Non-Administrative APIs**
  ([`get_maxar_wms_basemap()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/get_maxar_wms_basemap.md),
  [`get_maxar_wms_tiles()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/get_maxar_wms_tiles.md),
  [`vantor_get_seamlines()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_get_seamlines.md)):
  Accept **either** an API Key or an OAuth2 Bearer Token.
- **Browser-Based `leaflet` Tile Layers**
  ([`add_vantor_basemap()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/add_vantor_basemap.md),
  [`add_vantor_seamlines()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/add_vantor_seamlines.md),
  [`add_vantor_imagery()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/add_vantor_imagery.md)):
  Require an **API Key** (`maxar_api_key`).
- **Account Services / Admin APIs**
  ([`vantor_get_usage()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_get_usage.md)):
  Require an **OAuth2 Bearer Token** (`username` and `password`), as
  Vantor’s Admin APIs do not accept API keys.

You can configure credentials in your `.Renviron` file
(`VANTOR_API_KEY`, or `VANTOR_USERNAME` and `VANTOR_PASSWORD`) or set
them interactively for your R session with
[`vantor_auth()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_auth.md):

``` r

library(vantorr)

# Option 1: Set an API Key for the session (for OGC & Leaflet functions)
vantor_auth(api_key = "your_api_key")

# Option 2: Authenticate via OAuth2 (automatically caches and refreshes tokens;
# required for Admin endpoints such as vantor_get_usage())
vantor_auth(username = "your_email@example.com", password = "your_password")

# Check account credit usage and quota (requires OAuth2 Bearer token & Admin permissions)
usage <- vantor_get_usage(category = "PRODUCT", unit = "CREDIT")
```

## Retrieving WMS Basemaps & Seamlines

`vantorr` accepts spatial objects from `sf`, `terra`, and `stars` (as
well as numeric bounding boxes in `EPSG:4326` or `EPSG:3857`) and
automatically transforms coordinates to the required projection.

``` r

library(vantorr)
library(sf)
library(terra)

# Define an Area of Interest (AOI) in WGS84 (EPSG:4326)
aoi <- st_bbox(
  c(xmin = -77.040, ymin = 38.888, xmax = -77.030, ymax = 38.892),
  crs = st_crs(4326)
)

# Retrieve a 30cm Vivid Basemap directly as a terra SpatRaster
basemap_rast <- get_maxar_wms_basemap(
  bbox = aoi,
  resolution = 0.3,
  product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",
  return_type = "SpatRaster"
)

terra::plotRGB(basemap_rast, r = 1, g = 2, b = 3, stretch = "lin")

# Fetch vector seamline polygons and acquisition timestamps (OGC WFS)
seamlines_sf <- vantor_get_seamlines(bbox = aoi, product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30")
```

For larger areas of interest that exceed single-request pixel limits,
use
[`get_maxar_wms_tiles()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/get_maxar_wms_tiles.md)
to automatically grid, download, and mosaic tiles:

``` r

large_mosaic <- get_maxar_wms_tiles(
  bbox = aoi,
  tile_size = 2500,
  resolution = 0.3,
  merge_tiles = TRUE,
  return_type = "SpatRaster"
)
```

## Fieldwork Resources for Survey Data Collection

Generate alphanumeric survey index grids, audit imagery vintage across
Enumeration Areas, prepare CAPI sample preload tables (with offline
Google Plus Codes, ODK `geopoint` strings, and **World Bank Survey
Solutions** `.tab` assignment files), print multi-page PDF Field
Atlases, and export offline Esri Tile Packages (`.tpk` / `.tpkx` and
clean `_tpk.zip` upload archives) for **Survey Solutions** and **ArcGIS
Field Maps**:

``` r

# 1. Create a 500 m alphanumeric survey grid (A1, A2, B1, ...)
grid_sf <- vantor_survey_grid(aoi, cell_size = 500)

# 2. Audit imagery acquisition dates and flag outdated cells (> 2 years old)
vintage_grid <- vantor_vintage_report(grid_sf, seamlines = seamlines_sf, max_age_days = 730)

# 3. Export CAPI & Survey Solutions preload table and multi-page PDF Atlas
capi_pts <- vantor_export_capi(
  sample_pts,
  grid = vintage_grid,
  seamlines = seamlines_sf,
  output_suso_tab = "suso_assignments.tab",
  suso_gps_var = "hh_gps"
)
vantor_field_atlas(vintage_grid, points = capi_pts, raster = basemap_rast, output_file = "field_atlas.pdf")

# 4. Write a zoomable Esri Tile Package (.tpk + clean _tpk.zip) for Survey Solutions HQ
vantor_write_tpk(
  raster = basemap_rast,
  output_file = "ea_basemap.tpk",
  zoom = 15:17,
  zip_for_suso = TRUE
)
```

See
[`vignette("fieldwork-survey-resources", package = "vantorr")`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/articles/fieldwork-survey-resources.md)
and
[`vignette("survey-solutions-workflow", package = "vantorr")`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/articles/survey-solutions-workflow.md)
for the complete fieldwork and Survey Solutions guides.

## Interactive `leaflet` Maps & R Shiny Modules

Stream Vantor Vivid mosaics (`WMTS` or `WMS`), seamline cutlines
(`mode = "wms"` or interactive `mode = "wfs"` polygons), and archive
strips directly into `leaflet` maps, or embed the pre-built Shiny
modules
([`vantor_auth_ui()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_auth_ui.md)
and
[`vantor_explorer_ui()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_explorer_ui.md)):

``` r

library(leaflet)
library(vantorr)

# Stream Vantor Vivid 30cm WMTS tiles and seamlines in Leaflet
leaflet() |>
  setView(lng = -104.995, lat = 39.740, zoom = 15) |>
  add_vantor_basemap(
    product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",
    service = "WMTS",
    show_seamlines = TRUE
  )

# Launch the interactive Shiny Explorer demo app
if (interactive()) {
  run_vantor_demo_app()
}
```

See
[`vignette("shiny-leaflet-integration", package = "vantorr")`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/articles/shiny-leaflet-integration.md)
or visit the [companion website](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/)
for full documentation.

# Package index

## Authentication & Account Usage

Manage session credentials via API keys or OAuth2 bearer tokens (with
automatic refresh) and monitor account activation credit usage.

- [`vantor_auth()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_auth.md)
  : Authenticate with the Vantor / Maxar API
- [`vantor_has_auth()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_has_auth.md)
  : Check if Vantor Authentication is Available
- [`vantor_auth_clear()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_auth_clear.md)
  : Clear Stored Vantor Credentials
- [`get_maxar_token()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/get_maxar_token.md)
  : Get Maxar / Vantor API Bearer Token
- [`refresh_maxar_token()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/refresh_maxar_token.md)
  : Refresh Maxar / Vantor API Bearer Token
- [`create_maxar_request()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/create_maxar_request.md)
  : Create Maxar / Vantor API Request with Authentication
- [`vantor_get_usage()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_get_usage.md)
  : Get Vantor Account Usage and Credit Overview

## WMS Basemaps & Seamlines

Retrieve high-resolution Vivid Mosaic GeoTIFFs, multi-tile mosaics, and
vector seamline polygons with acquisition metadata.

- [`get_maxar_wms_basemap()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/get_maxar_wms_basemap.md)
  : Get Maxar / Vantor WMS Basemap as GeoTIFF or Spatial Raster Object

- [`get_maxar_wms_tiles()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/get_maxar_wms_tiles.md)
  : Get Multiple WMS Basemap Tiles for Large Areas

- [`vantor_get_seamlines()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_get_seamlines.md)
  :

  Get Vantor Basemap Seamlines as an `sf` Object (OGC WFS)

## Fieldwork & Survey Data Collection Resources

Generate alphanumeric survey index grids, audit imagery vintage across
Enumeration Areas, encode offline Plus Codes, export CAPI preload files
(ODK, Kobo, Survey123), print multi-page PDF Field Atlases, and bundle
offline GeoPackages and Esri Tile Packages (.tpk / .tpkx) for Survey
Solutions and ArcGIS Field Maps.

- [`vantor_survey_grid()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_survey_grid.md)
  : Generate an Alphanumeric Survey Index Grid over an Area of Interest

- [`vantor_vintage_report()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_vintage_report.md)
  : Audit Basemap Imagery Vintage and Sensor Quality Across Survey Areas

- [`vantor_plus_code()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_plus_code.md)
  : Encode Coordinates as Open Location Codes (Google Plus Codes)

- [`vantor_export_capi()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_export_capi.md)
  : Prepare and Export Survey Sample Points for CAPI Fieldwork Apps

- [`vantor_field_atlas()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_field_atlas.md)
  : Generate a Printable Multi-Page Field Atlas (PDF Map Book)

- [`vantor_offline_package()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_offline_package.md)
  : Package Offline Fieldwork Vector Layers and Satellite Basemaps

- [`vantor_write_tpk()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_write_tpk.md)
  :

  Write an Esri Tile Package (`.tpk` or `.tpkx`) for Offline Field
  Basemaps

## Interactive Mapping (leaflet)

Stream Vantor Vivid mosaics, seamline overlays, and archive strips
directly into interactive leaflet web maps.

- [`vantor_wmts_url()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_wmts_url.md)
  : Construct a Vantor OGC WMTS Tile URL Template
- [`add_vantor_basemap()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/add_vantor_basemap.md)
  [`addVantorBasemap()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/add_vantor_basemap.md)
  : Add a Vantor Vivid Mosaic Basemap to a Leaflet Map
- [`add_vantor_seamlines()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/add_vantor_seamlines.md)
  [`addVantorSeamlines()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/add_vantor_seamlines.md)
  : Add Vantor Basemap Seamlines to a Leaflet Map
- [`add_vantor_imagery()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/add_vantor_imagery.md)
  [`addVantorImagery()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/add_vantor_imagery.md)
  : Add Vantor Archive Streaming Imagery to a Leaflet Map

## R Shiny Application Modules

Drop-in, namespace-safe Shiny UI and server modules for authentication,
interactive AOI selection, seamline inspection, and GeoTIFF export.

- [`vantor_auth_ui()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_auth_ui.md)
  : Vantor Authentication Shiny Module UI
- [`vantor_auth_server()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_auth_server.md)
  : Vantor Authentication Shiny Module Server
- [`vantor_explorer_ui()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_explorer_ui.md)
  : Vantor Interactive Imagery Explorer Shiny Module UI
- [`vantor_explorer_server()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_explorer_server.md)
  : Vantor Interactive Imagery Explorer Shiny Module Server
- [`run_vantor_demo_app()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/run_vantor_demo_app.md)
  : Launch Interactive Vantor Explorer Demo Shiny App

## Spatial Dispatch & Coordinate Helpers

S3 bounding box coercion across sf, terra, and stars spatial classes.

- [`vantor_as_bbox()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/vantor_as_bbox.md)
  : Coerce Spatial Objects to a Bounding Box in a Target CRS
- [`convert_bbox_to_3857()`](https://michael-cw.github.io/vantorr/reference/convert_bbox_to_3857.md)
  : Convert Lat/Lon Bounding Box to Web Mercator
